about: What fails at the legacy 1.4.x code, one entry per defect: id (KD-NNN), ownerIssue, evidence (a GitHub link pinned to a full commit SHA, with a line anchor), tests (titles that carry the id; empty when the entry only lists uncaught messages), and optional uncaught (exact messages of exceptions the smoke tests tolerate). A listed test that passes, or a listed message that no longer occurs, fails the run. The PR that fixes the defect deletes its entry, turns its tests into plain tests, and drops the id from their titles. Harness tests are declared with test.fail(title, body), and e2e/harness/expected-failures.js checks every expected failure as it runs; node tests use expectFailure(title, body) from test/helpers/expect-failure.js; test/known-defects.test.js checks titles and entries match both ways. Format: e2e/harness/known-defects.js.

tests: KD-001 sidebar search for a word only in a block's text finds the note
KD-002 the capture-selection command saves the selected text and its source to today's Daily Note
KD-003 createNote resolves only once its note is stored
KD-004 saveElement resolves only once its block is stored
KD-005 exportAll includes the links between notes
KD-006 connecting WebDAV stores no plaintext copy of the password
KD-007 Gemini requests carry the API key outside their URL
KD-008 a URL pasted with focus in a block with text becomes a bookmark right after that block
